papers.title_en: Reducing the Risk of Unintentional Doping From Supplements: A Practical Guide for Athletes and Support Teams
papers.title_zh: 降低膳食补充剂导致无意兴奋剂违规的风险：运动员和支持团队的实用指南
papers.tldr_en: The proposed framework integrates efficacy, evidence quality, mechanisms of action, contamination pathways, behavioural determinants, strict liability and antidoping risk to support safer supplementation decisions to protect athlete health and the integrity of clean sport.
papers.abstract_en: Context Dietary supplements are widely used across all levels of sport. While the ‘food first but not food only’ approach remains central to sports nutrition, selected supplements may support performance, recovery or health when used appropriately. However, variable regulation, product contamination, mislabelling and inappropriate decision‐making may expose athletes to inadvertent antidoping rule violations (ADRVs). Evidence Acquisition This structured narrative review searched PubMed and Scopus for literature published between January 2000 and December 2025. Evidence from primary studies, randomised controlled trials, systematic reviews, meta‐analyses, mechanistic studies, contamination analyses, behavioural research, consensus statements and official guidance documents from major sports and antidoping organisations was critically evaluated and synthesised. papers.abstract_zh: 背景 膳食补充剂在各级体育运动中被广泛使用。尽管“食物优先但非食物唯一”的方法仍是运动营养的核心，但适当使用的特定补充剂可以支持表现、恢复或健康。然而，多变的法规、产品污染、错误标签以及不当决策可能会使运动员面临无意反兴奋剂规则违规（ADRVs）的风险。证据获取 本结构化叙述性综述检索了PubMed和Scopus中2000年1月至2025年12月期间发表的文献。证据来自主要研究，[...]

papers.title_en: Investigating the Impact of Preoperative Kinesiophobia and Pain on Postoperative Gait Biomechanics Following Anterior Cruciate Ligament Injury
papers.title_zh: 探讨术前运动恐惧症和疼痛对前交叉韧带损伤后术后步态生物力学的影响
papers.tldr_en: Preoperative kinesiophobia, but not pain, was weakly associated with lower KAM impulses during early to midphases of clinical recovery at 4 months after ACLR.
papers.abstract_en: Background: Aberrant gait biomechanics—ie, lower knee abduction moment (KAM) impulse— are linked to the development of posttraumatic osteoarthritis after anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) injury and ACL reconstruction (ACLR). There is a clinical need to identify modifiable factors, such as kinesiophobia and pain, that may contribute to aberrant gait development after ACLR to advance multimodal rehabilitation strategies. Purpose/Hypothesis: This study aimed to determine associations between preoperative kinesiophobia and pain and gait biomechanics linked to posttraumatic osteoarthritis development at 2 and 4 months after ACLR. We hypothesized that worse preoperative kinesiophobia and pain would be associated with lower KAM impulses in the ACLR limb but not the uninjured limb at 2 and 4 months after ACLR. papers.abstract_zh: 背景：异常步态生物力学——即较低的膝关节外展力矩（KAM）冲量——与前交叉韧带（ACL）损伤和ACL重建（ACLR）后创伤后骨关节炎的发生发展相关。临床上需要识别可调节的因素，例如运动恐惧症和疼痛，这些因素可能导致ACLR术后异常步态的发生，从而推进多模式康复策略。目的/假设：本研究旨在确定术前运动恐惧症、疼痛与创伤后骨关节炎发生相关的步态生物力学之间的关联。

papers.title_en: Lower Extremity Mechanical Energetics During Walking 6 Months Following Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction
papers.title_zh: 前交叉韧带重建术后6个月步行期间的下肢机械能学
papers.journal: Scandinavian Journal of Medicine and Science in Sports
papers.tldr_en: Compared to contralateral limbs and matched controls, individuals at 6 months post ACLR exhibit altered lower extremity mechanical energetics, with decreased knee contributions and a greater hip contribution during walking.
papers.abstract_en: Aberrant gait biomechanics following anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) injury and ACL reconstruction (ACLR) are critical factors contributing to the development of knee osteoarthritis (KOA). However, it remains unknown how ACLR impacts lower extremity joint energetics and each joint's contribution to total limb energetics during walking. To compare mechanical energetics at the ankle, knee, and hip joints between ACLR limbs, contralateral, and control limbs during walking. Forty‐four participants with primary unilateral ACLR (post‐ACLR: 6.0 ± 0.2 months) and 44 uninjured controls were studied. Ankle, knee, and hip joint work were calculated as the time integral of the negative (energy dissipation) or positive (energy generation) regions of the respective stance‐phase joint power curves. papers.abstract_zh: 前交叉韧带（ACL）损伤和ACL重建术（ACLR）后的异常步态生物力学是导致膝骨关节炎（KOA）发生的关键因素。然而，ACLR如何影响下肢关节能量学以及每个关节在步行期间对总肢体能量学的贡献仍不清楚。旨在比较ACLR肢体、对侧肢体和对照肢体在步行期间踝关节、膝关节和髋关节的机械能学。研究了44名初次单侧ACLR受试者（ACLR术后：6.0±0.2个月）和44名未受伤的对照组受试者。[...]

papers.title_en: Clinical applications of wearable sensor-based gait analysis in athletes: a systematic review for injury prevention and rehabilitation
papers.title_zh: 基于可穿戴传感器的步态分析在运动员中的临床应用：损伤预防和康复的系统综述
papers.journal: BMC Sports Science Medicine and Rehabilitation
papers.journal_tier: 康复医学2区/运动科学3区
papers.tldr_en: Evaluating the clinical efficacy of wearable sensor–based gait analysis for injury prevention in athletes, examining its role in rehabilitation monitoring and clinical decision-making, and identifying methodological limitations and future research priorities required for standardized clinical integration identifies key challenges.
papers.abstract_en: Gait analysis is fundamental for optimizing athletic performance and mitigating injury risks in sports medicine. While traditional laboratory assessments offer insights, the emergence of wearable sensor technology provides novel opportunities for objective, real-time gait evaluation in ecologically valid settings. This systematic review aims to (1) evaluate the clinical efficacy of wearable sensor–based gait analysis for injury prevention in athletes (2), examine its role in rehabilitation monitoring and clinical decision-making, and (3) identify methodological limitations and future research priorities required for standardized clinical integration. Adhering to PRISMA 2020 guidelines, a systematic search was conducted across MEDLINE, Web of Science, Scopus, and Embase from inception to May 31st, 2025. papers.abstract_zh: 步态分析对于优化运动表现和降低运动医学中的损伤风险至关重要。尽管传统的实验室评估提供了见解，但可穿戴传感器技术的出现为在生态有效环境中进行客观、实时的步态评估提供了新的机会。本系统综述旨在 (1) 评估基于可穿戴传感器的步态分析在运动员损伤预防中的临床疗效，(2) 考察其在康复监测和临床决策中的作用，以及 (3) 识别方法学局限性和未来研究方向。

papers.title_en: Building for the Future: A Systematic Review of the Effects of Eccentric Resistance Training on Measures of Physical Performance in Youth Athletes
papers.title_zh: 展望未来：离心阻力训练对青少年运动员身体表现指标影响的系统综述
papers.tldr_en: The findings of this systematic review support the inclusion of eccentric resistance training in youth athletes to improve measures of muscular strength, jump, sprint and change of direction performance.
papers.abstract_en: Background Eccentric resistance training is recognised as an effective stimulus for enhancing measures of muscular strength and power in adult populations; however, its value in youth athletes is currently not well understood. Objective The aim of this systematic review was to critically appraise the effects of eccentric resistance training on measures of physical performance (i.e. muscular strength, jump, sprint and change of direction) in youth athletes 18 years of age and under. Methods Original journal articles published between 1950 and June 2022 were retrieved from electronic search engines of PubMed, SPORTDiscus and Google Scholar’s advanced search option. papers.title_en: Effects of different dietary supplements combined with conditioning training on muscle strength, jump performance, sprint speed, and muscle mass in athletes: a systematic review and network meta-analysis
papers.title_zh: 不同膳食补充剂与体能训练结合对运动员肌肉力量、跳跃表现、冲刺速度和肌肉量的影响：一项系统综述和网络荟萃分析
papers.tldr_en: Protein supplementation appears to be the most effective strategy for increasing muscular strength; β-alanine and creatine both improve jump performance, with β-alanine offering marginally superior effectiveness; and creatine is particularly beneficial for sprint speed.
papers.abstract_en: Background As dietary supplements have become integral to meeting athletes’ specialised nutritional requirements, research into their effects on performance has intensified. Yet inconsistent findings leave the efficacy of some supplements—most notably branched-chain amino acids and β-hydroxy-β-methylbutyrate (HMB)—open to debate. To clarify which products offer the greatest benefit, we undertook a systematic review and network meta-analysis aimed at identifying the supplements most effective for athletes, including protein, creatine, β-alanine, HMB, vitamin D, caffeine, and others. Methods PubMed, Web of Science, the Cochrane Library, Embase and SPORTDiscus were searched from database inception to 15 March 2024 for RCTs evaluating the effects of dietary supplements (including but not limited to protein, creatine, β-alanine, HMB, caffeine, and vitamin D) on athletic performance. papers.abstract_zh: 背景 随着膳食补充剂成为满足运动员特殊营养需求不可或缺的一部分，对其性能影响的研究也随之加剧。然而，不一致的研究结果使得某些补充剂——最显著的是支链氨基酸和β-羟基-β-甲基丁酸（HMB）——的功效仍存在争议。为了阐明哪些产品能提供最大益处，我们进行了一项系统综述和网络荟萃分析，旨在确定对运动员最有效的补充剂，包括蛋白质、肌酸、β-丙氨酸、HMB、维生素D、咖啡因等。方法 [...]
